object.name: Tau Cet
object.notes: 10pc census (2023-08-25), object 44, system 21; tau Cet. J2000 Sun-relative Galactic position via Astropy; full-space-motion. Absolute Johnson V derived from 10pc Vmag=3.5 and adopted distance; negligible extinction assumed. Photometric epoch, uncertainty and individual V bibliography not supplied by compilation. No orbital model. Source caution: tau Cet e f g h: candidate planets 2017AJ....154..135F Tau Ceti reviewed physical parameters. Korolik et al. (2023) combine CHARA interferometry and EXPRES spectroscopy; their measured temperature supersedes the earlier spectral-class estimate, and their luminosity is reported in the paper's literature-comparison table. Di Folco et al. (2004) infer the adopted age from stellar-evolution modelling. Pagano et al. (2015) measure [Fe/H] from high-resolution MIKE spectra. Retain the 2006 optical subtype cited by the 10pc census and restore its dwarf luminosity class, rather than reverting to the older G8V classification.
